body.condition: The assignment fields \(D^{(1)}\) and \(D^{(2)}\) are conditionally independent given \(\mathcal F_U\) under \(P\).

novel.justification: Large online populations can be rerandomized after a prespecified washout interval while retaining the same network, eligibility frame, exposure map, and potential-outcome schedule; the condition formalizes that repeated-experiment design.
